jobs.title: Aluminium Top Clamp, the Z1’s preloaded first job

source.title: Makera Z1 Quick Start — Top Clamp

jobs.sentence: As Makera ships it, in aluminium, the job is refused: there are no feeds for the metal O-flute. On a plastic stand-in the app cuts the same part Makera’s own program cuts: the clamp, its slot, the two shoulders, the chamfered corners and three tabs.

jobs.title: Personalised spoon rest, a hexagon with a raised letter
jobs.sentence: No program. With its four tabs the job is refused because one tab is counted as a loose 38 mm² piece; without tabs, the frame file is refused because it would move outside the machine at Z 0.
jobs.modelled: Read from the maker's Carbide Create file: the 145 mm hexagon, the rest pocket and the handle notch. The file pockets with a 3D component (a sloped floor) that cannot be read here, so the rest is a flat 6 mm pocket around a raised serif M (the photo's letter).
jobs.material: PLA (the maker cut hardwood; this shop cuts printed plastics, not wood)

results.refusal: loose-piece: The through cuts leave a piece of the blank (38 mm²) disconnected from the material the mount holds. It can move under the cutter after being freed; leave a connecting bridge of material, move the cut away from the blank’s edges, or add holding tabs.

jobs.sentence: Cut as two jobs, the lines and the diamond outline come out as in the photo. As one job it is refused: a V-bit cannot be followed by the flat cut-out. The outline can only be cut without tabs, because tabs are refused on its traced straight sides.
jobs.modelled: The maker's own artwork PNG traced by the app's raster importer; the black lines milled 0.35 mm through a 0.2 mm yellow cap, the sign 110 mm across, cut out of 1.6 mm laminate. Cap thickness and size are assumed.

runs.title: As drawn: one job, two cutters

results.refusal: setup-rest-unavailable: Setup 1 names inv:kz-engrave-30-0-5 first and then another cutter, but a V-bit is not a rest cutter here — on a region job it is the V-carve cutter itself, not a second program. The V-carve is the whole region job; remove the later cutter from the setup, or name a flat cutter first.

tab-unplaceable: Cut-out "Cut out outside Pocket outline (1 contour, 110×110mm)" asks for 4 holding tabs 3 mm wide, but 4 could not be placed on a straight edge long enough; the part would be released where that tab was meant to hold it. Use a smaller tab width or count.
